name: Toochika Misaki
source:
She is the granddaughter of the School President, and is assigned the special role of "School Deputy Director". Because of that, she always tries to act as a well-mannered model student which has caused her to be popular with both genders.

However, she is a bit weak to unforeseen circumstances and her being an good natured person makes her dignity as the Principal's School Deputy Director drop a little. Basically, she's good at taking care of everyone, but if you get her angry a strange side of her comes out.

"Aah... Why is it always like this with you Shindou-kun?"
